home.metaDescription: Scollarly helps African students find and apply to Indian universities. Free for students, with a team that answers on WhatsApp.

hero.title: Study in India from Africa
hero.subtitle: We connect African students with Indian universities and help with every step, from results to arrival.

unpublish.title: Take this off the site?
unpublish.body: Visitors will stop seeing it. It stays here as a draft.

archive.title: Archive this?
archive.body: It moves out of the way and, if it was live, comes off the site. Nothing is deleted, and you can restore it.

restore.title: Restore this?
restore.body: It comes back as a draft. It is not live until you publish it.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.notFound: That item does not exist any more.
errors.storage: The image storage is not reachable right now. Try again in a moment.

content.archivedNotice: This item is archived and cannot be edited. Restore it to work on it again.

gate.title: Publish this?
gate.ready: It will be visible to everyone on the public site.
gate.refused: It cannot be published yet. Check the highlighted fields.

help.slug: Part of the page address. Letters, numbers and hyphens. It cannot be changed after you save.
help.key: Names the place the text appears. It cannot be changed after you save.
help.dataConfirmed: Tick only when you have checked the amounts with the university. Visitors see only confirmed fees.
help.amountMin: Must be more than 0 to confirm.
help.youtubeId: The 11 characters after v= in a YouTube address.
help.verified: Tick when you have checked this person is a real student of ours.
help.confirmed: Tick only when you have checked this is true. Unconfirmed items are never shown.
help.consentId: Needed before this can go live. It records that the person agreed to be shown.
help.photoMediaId: A photo of a document must have its private details hidden before you upload it.
help.body: Markdown works: # headings, **bold**, - lists and [links](https://example.com). Raw HTML is shown as plain text.

tokens.IMMUTABLE: This cannot be changed after the first save.
tokens.FEE_RANGE: A confirmed fee needs a lowest amount above 0 and a highest amount at least as large.

tokens.NEEDS_HTTPS_URL: A tour or gallery needs a link that starts with https://.
tokens.REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: One of the chosen items no longer exists. Reload.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.intro: How visitors become leads, and where leads come from. All dates are in West Africa Time (Douala).

problems.FUTURE: The last day cannot be in the future.
problems.ORDER: The first day must not be after the last day.
problems.TOO_LONG: Choose a range of at most one year.
problems.UNKNOWN_VALUE: Choose one of the countries in the list.

analytics.limits: Counts can be lower than real traffic because of ad blockers and offline visits.

funnel.visitsOff: Page views are not being counted at the moment (the owner switched them off to save database use), so the funnel starts at WhatsApp taps.
funnel.empty: No visits, taps or leads in this range yet.

performance.basis: Reply times are based on the replies you logged, not on when a message was sent on WhatsApp. Overdue means unanswered and past its target time, whatever the dates above.

payments.title: Payments received
payments.count: {count, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}} in this range, voided ones left out.
payments.none: No payments were recorded in this range.
payments.note: Payments are counted by the date the money was received.
payments.countryNote: The country filter does not apply here: a payment is not tied to a student's country.
payments.open: Open the Payments page for this range

payments.title: Payments received
payments.intro: Money that universities paid to Scollarly, in US dollars. A payment is never edited: if one is wrong, void it with a reason and enter the correct one.
payments.exportTooMany: Too many payments for one file. Narrow the dates and try again.
payments.exportFailed: The file could not be downloaded. Check your connection and the filters, then try again.
payments.errorFilters: Check the filters: the dates must be real and the first day must not be after the last.
payments.totalsNote: Totals leave out voided payments and follow the university and date filters.
payments.empty: No payments have been recorded yet.
payments.truncated: Only the newest {count} payments are listed. Narrow the dates to see older ones.
payments.recordBody: Enter what the university paid. You cannot edit it afterwards.
payments.errorNetwork: You seem to be offline. Nothing was saved.
payments.errorTokenReused: This form was already used. Close it and open it again to enter another payment.
payments.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Nothing was saved.

fieldErrors.INVALID: This is not valid. For an amount, write dollars and cents, for example 1500.00.
fieldErrors.FUTURE_DATE: The date cannot be in the future.
fieldErrors.UNKNOWN_VALUE: That choice no longer exists. Reload the page.

payments.voidBody: It stays on record, struck through, and is left out of the totals. This cannot be undone.

performanceAll.title: Every admin's performance
performanceAll.intro: Leads handled, first-reply time and overdue leads for each admin. Only the owner sees this page.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: These settings are used across the site. Saving needs a code from your authenticator app.
settings.whatsappHint: Write a + first, then the country code and the number, with no spaces. Every WhatsApp button on the site uses it.
settings.phoneDisplay: Phone number shown on the site
settings.phoneDisplayHint: Written the way visitors should read it, with spaces if you like. The Contact page shows it.
settings.slaHint: Applies to leads received after you save. Leads already received keep their target.
settings.freshnessHint: A lead counts as fresh if its stage moved in the last N days. Leave empty until you have set a target.
settings.staleTour: A tour or link is stale after (days)
settings.budgetHint: Between {min} and {max} MiB. You get a warning at 70%.
settings.collectHint: Switch off to stop counting page views and save database use. WhatsApp taps and leads are still counted.
settings.timezoneValue: {zone} (West Africa Time). Times are stored in UTC and shown in this zone. It cannot be changed.
settings.futureOnly: A change affects what happens after you save. It does not rewrite leads or payments already stored.
settings.savedSite: Saved. The public site is refreshing and will show the new details within about 30 seconds.
settings.savedSiteLater: Saved. The public site could not be told to refresh, so it will catch up by itself within about an hour.
settings.errorStepUp: Your authenticator code was not confirmed, so nothing was saved.
settings.errorFields: Some values are not valid. Nothing was saved.
settings.errorNetwork: You seem to be offline. Nothing was saved.
settings.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Nothing was saved.

fieldErrors.INVALID: This value is not allowed. Check the range under the field.
fieldErrors.PHONE_INVALID: Write a + and the number with its country code, 7 to 15 digits.

settings.exportBody: Download everything stored in the database as one file, for your own backup. It has no pictures (they are in image storage) and none of the secrets. It contains personal data, so keep it safe.
settings.exportError: The export could not be made. Please try again.

next.share_results: Send your school results to us on WhatsApp. We read them and tell you which courses fit.
next.choose_course: Talk to us about the courses and choose the ones you want to apply for.
next.offer_letter: We are working on your offer letter with the university. We will message you as soon as it is ready.
next.confirm_admission: Confirm your place with the university. Message us if you need help with the fees or the papers.
next.visa: Get your student visa ready. We will tell you which papers you need and help you check them.
next.arrived: You have arrived. Message us any time if you need help settling in.

progress.title: My application
progress.stepsLabel: The six steps of your application
progress.nextFallback: Message your admin on WhatsApp to ask what comes next.
progress.whatsappText: Hello, my Scollarly reference is {ref}. My application is at the step "{stage}".
progress.whatsappMissing: The WhatsApp number is not available right now. Please try again later.
progress.others: {count, plural, one {You have # other application linked to this account.} other {You have # other applications linked to this account.}}

matching.title: We are matching your application
matching.body: We have not linked an application to your account yet. If you already applied, ask us to link it. If you have not applied, you can start from the Apply page.
matching.pending: {count, plural, one {Your request is waiting for an admin to confirm it.} other {Your # requests are waiting for an admin to confirm them.}}

offline.body: You're offline. This is the last progress saved on this phone, and it may be out of date.

link.title: Link my application
link.intro: If you already applied, tell us how to find your application and an admin will confirm that it is yours. Nothing is linked until an admin confirms it.
link.reference: Your reference or the WhatsApp number you applied with
link.help: The reference looks like SC-ABCDE-12345. A number can start with + and the country code, for example +237…
link.country: Country of the number (only if it does not start with +)
link.countryHelp: Choose it when you type a number the way you dial it at home, without the country code.
link.sent: Request sent. An admin will confirm. You will see your progress here once they do.

errors.REQUIRED: Enter your reference or your number.
errors.INVALID: That does not look like a reference or a phone number.
errors.NEEDS_COUNTRY: Choose the country of the number, or start it with + and the country code.
errors.UNKNOWN_VALUE: Choose one of the countries in the list.
errors.NETWORK: You're offline. Try again when you are back online.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: You have sent several requests today. Please try again tomorrow, or message us on WhatsApp.

profile.title: My profile
profile.name: Name

data.title: My data
data.intro: You decide what we keep. You can download everything we hold about you, or ask us to delete it.

export.title: Download my data
export.body: A file with your account details and your applications, as you gave them to us. It is made when you ask for it and is not stored anywhere.

errors.NETWORK: You're offline. Try again when you are back online.

erase.title: Delete my data
erase.body: We remove your name, number and email from your applications, and we delete your account. You will be signed out and cannot sign in with it again. This cannot be undone.

kept.payments: Payments that universities made to Scollarly stay on record, without any link to you.
kept.counts: Anonymous counts, such as how many applications we had in a month, stay.

erase.warning: This removes your details from every application and deletes your account. It cannot be undone.
erase.reauth: For your safety, sign in again first. Deleting needs a sign-in from the last 10 minutes. After you sign in, come back to this page.
erase.done: Your details were removed and your account was deleted. You are signed out.

errors.NETWORK: You're offline. Try again when you are back online.
errors.STAFF: A team account cannot delete itself. Ask the owner to remove your team access first.
